mission: REPMILE HR5 RUNNA PARITY CORRECTION (V1HR5R), Founder decision of 2026-11-25 (audits/v1-hr5-runna-parity-2026-11-25/FOUNDER_REQUEST.md)
reason: Founder product decision: every athlete with a valid age (18-80) gets five heart-rate zones from 220 - age with no watch, strap, lab or history, Runna-style (Z1 up to 65 %, Z2 to 81, Z3 to 89, Z4 to 97, Z5 above, of maximum heart rate), personalisable (a declared maximum, custom limits), estimated / declared / measured references kept apart; heart rate never changes the plan. It corrects V1HR5 (REPMILE-COACHINGCORE-V1-FIVE-ZONE-AMENDMENT-1) in place: no parallel system.

method.values: CoachingCore/v1/HEART_RATE_FIVE_ZONE_V2.json (V1X-HR-FIVE-ZONE-2), pinned 784ba7feb3e4c61efc9ec2187e23d4abdc78504519b40559bbfc53325e75ca90; the revision-1 values kept byte for byte as history
method.summary: Whole-bpm upper limit of Z_k = floor(max x percent / 100), next zone one bpm above (exact, no gap, no overlap); readings rounded half up. Reference order: athlete-declared maximum > qualifying lab maximum > chest-strap observed maximum above the age estimate > 220 - age (18-80; none past 80). A lab/strap conflict uses neither measured value. Custom limits replace the percentages and are kept as set. Single measured values classified one by one (never a distribution); time in zone only from a sufficient series (future channel). Session roles of revision 1 kept (effort governs; a Z4 slow-down cue in easy running; never primary); walk/jog, restart and return keep the zones with no session role; a hold withholds them.
